# Psalms of Solomon — Psalm 11 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Vindobonensis) | **Section:** The Gathering of Exiles to Jerusalem

---

**11:1** Sound in Zion the trumpet of the sanctuary!
Proclaim in Jerusalem the voice of one who brings good news!

**11:2** For God has shown mercy to Israel
by visiting them.

**11:3** Stand on a high place, O Jerusalem, and behold your children,
gathered from east to west by the LORD.

**11:4** From the north they come, gathered by God;
from the distant islands God has gathered them.

**11:5** He leveled great mountains to a plain for them;
the hills fled before their coming.

**11:6** The forests gave them shade as they passed;
God made every fragrant tree to spring up for them,

**11:7** that Israel might walk in the glory of God.
Put on your robes of glory, O Jerusalem, your holy garments;

**11:8** clothe yourself in your holy vestments, O Jerusalem,
for God has spoken good things for Israel forever and ever.

**11:9** May the LORD perform what he has promised for Israel and Jerusalem;
may the LORD lift up Israel by his glorious name.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering integrating EMET, LOGOS, and PNEUMA. Preferred readings noted where agents diverge.*
